name: Malvera Ember Throne
passives: Dominion Flame — Malvera's Mastery: Malvera's Dominion Flame: a solo zone conversion that grows when the Titan uses chains, fire, and cursed ground to control enemies instead of relying on allies. Counterplay remains: deny favored terrain, force reaction bait, drain Momentum or Divinity.
lore: Malvera Ember Throne is a colossal Infernal Dominion sustain from The Infernal Dominion. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Titan is the older source: Infernal Dominion sustain office: restoration rite, continuity keeper, mercy under law; Goetia/grimoires: seals, names, summoning law, constrained powers.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source Titan, not a costume: Malvera Ember Throne shows black iron crowns, volcanic glass armor, contract parchment skin, chain mantles, ember fissures, horn hierarchies, bat/dragon wing shadows, clawed court gloves, blood wax seals, ash velvet, obsidian thrones, coin/debt motifs, execution architecture.. Role silhouette must read as Sustain. Materials include black iron, volcanic glass, obsidian, blood wax, ash velvet, molten gold, charred parchment. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid red robot demon, generic Halloween devil, sci-fi cables, literal castle armor, block fortress body, cartoon pitchfork.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, named gear, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Malvera Restoring Strike
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Infernal damage at range 2; gain 8 Momentum, or 12 if used from burning terrain or into the Titan's marked target.
abilityDetails.counterplay: Line-of-sight denial, evasion, armor, or forcing low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Crown Renewal Circuit
abilityDetails.effect: Apply cleanse, heal-over-time, attrition defense; also builds 10 Dominion Heat when it changes enemy intent or breaks an objective action.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Malvera Ember Throne: Survival Covenant
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Dominion Heat to create a two-round battlefield rule around burning terrain; enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum, or trigger the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Crown Infernal Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: +15% damage, +12 mitigation, empowered Dominion Heat, and one mythic reaction override. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Dominion Crown Implement
equipmentDetails.effect: +2 attack. Empowered basics against vulnerable enemies generate +4 Momentum but cannot trigger more than once per round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action generation; damage bonus capped against bosses.

equipmentDetails.name: Malvera Ember Throne Realmplate
equipmentDetails.effect: +2 armor and +3 resistance. First preventable hazard hit each battle is reduced by 25% if the Titan used a reaction last round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Hazard reduction does not prevent scripted boss mechanics.

equipmentDetails.name: Malvera Dominion Heat Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Dominion Heat cap +20. At 80+ Dominion Heat, the next Technique gains a role-specific rider, then drains 30 Dominion Heat.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: One empowered Technique per two rounds; cannot chain with Ascension opener.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: win attrition and cleanse hazard pressure
